malawi.title: Flag of the Republic of Malawi

colors.note: Represents the indigenous peoples of the African continent.
Symbolises the blood shed in the struggle for African independence.
Represents Malawi's evergreen landscape and agriculture.
The red rising sun represents the dawn of hope and freedom over Africa.

desc:
- Three equal horizontal bands of black, red, and green with a red rising sun centred on the black band
- The rising sun bears 31 rays, marking Malawi as the 31st African nation to gain independence
- Adopted on 6 July 1964 at independence from the United Kingdom; colours derive from the Pan-African palette
trivia:
- The 31-ray rising sun commemorates Malawi being the 31st African country to achieve independence
- Between 2010 and 2012 a redesign placed a full white sun at centre; it was reverted after public opposition
- Based on the flag of the Malawi Congress Party, which led the independence movement
- The rising sun also symbolises hope for the whole African continent
